# Stout Creek Barbershop

> Family barbershop based in Ellettsville, Indiana. A small, quiet family barbershop between Ellettsville and Bloomington. Sharp fades, classic cuts and real patience with little ones, from barbers who know you by name.

- Phone: (812) 876-9980
- Based in: Ellettsville, IN
- Nearby areas: Ellettsville, Bloomington, Stinesville, Spencer, Gosport
- Google rating: 4.8 from 165 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/indiana/stout-creek-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/indiana/stout-creek-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Men's haircuts: Tell us what you like. Classic or modern, clippers or scissors, you leave lined up and looking your best.
- Fades & tapers: Low, mid or high, blended clean. Ask for a skin fade or keep a little length.
- Kids & first haircuts: Toddlers included. Our barbers are patient and fun, and they help nervous little ones feel at home.
- Flat tops & military cuts: High and tights, flat tops and short regulation cuts, kept square and sharp.
- Side parts & hard parts: Old-school side parts and crisp hard parts, finished neat.
- Beard trims: Shape it up or clean it up. Book a beard trim on its own, or a cut and beard together.

## About
Stout Creek Barbershop sits right off Highway 46 between Ellettsville and Bloomington. Inside it's all Indiana barbershop: red leather Belmont chairs, hex lights overhead from the recent remodel, and Route 66 signs, a Marathon globe and antique barber poles on the walls. Jarrett, Austin and Dustin keep the chairs moving. Customers say the conversation is always top-shelf and the guys know how to treat people young and old, from toddlers getting their very first cut to regulars who've been coming in for years. Grab a Stout Creek sticker on your way out.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Tuesday 8 AM to 6 PM. Wednesday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM with a lunch break from 12 to 1. Saturday 8 AM to 2 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Yes, we're by appointment. Book online or call (812) 876-9980. Openings come up during the week, so it's worth checking for a last-minute spot.
- Q: Do you cut toddlers' and kids' hair?
  A: Yes, all the time. Our barbers are patient with nervous little ones and kids who need a little extra care, and first haircuts are some of our favorite cuts.
- Q: Is this the old Steve's Barbershop?
  A: Same spot, same phone number. The shop at 5585 IN-46 is now Stout Creek Barbershop.
- Q: Do you do flat tops and military cuts?
  A: Yes. High and tights, flat tops, buzz cuts and other short regulation cuts.
- Q: How do I pay?
  A: Venmo is welcome, and there are other easy ways to pay too. Ask at the chair.
